stem: Points \(A\), \(B\), and \(C\) lie on the circle with center \(O\). The radius of the circle is 9, and angle \(ACB\) measures \(40^{\circ}\). What is the length of minor arc \(AB\)?
solution: An inscribed angle is half the central angle that intercepts the same arc, so the central angle \(AOB\) is \(2 \cdot 40 = 80^{\circ}\).

explanation.A: Incorrect. This uses \(40^{\circ}\) as the central angle. The inscribed angle is half the central angle, so the central angle is \(80^{\circ}\).
explanation.B: Correct. The central angle is \(80^{\circ}\), so the arc is \(\frac{80}{360} \cdot 18\pi = 4\pi\).
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is \(\frac{80}{360} \cdot 2\pi(18)\); it uses 18, the diameter, in place of the radius.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is the major arc, \(18\pi - 4\pi\), not the minor arc.

verify:
P=figure['points']
d=lambda a,b: sqrt((P[a][0]-P[b][0])**2+(P[a][1]-P[b][1])**2)
ang=lambda a,v,b: N(acos(((P[a][0]-P[v][0])*(P[b][0]-P[v][0])+(P[a][1]-P[v][1])*(P[b][1]-P[v][1]))/(d(a,v)*d(b,v)))*180/pi)
assert abs(d('O','A')-9)<0.01 and abs(d('O','B')-9)<0.01 and abs(d('O','C')-9)<0.01
assert abs(ang('A','C','B')-40)<0.1 and abs(ang('A','O','B')-80)<0.1
ans=2*pi*9*Rational(2*40,360)
assert simplify(value(choices[answer])-ans)==0 and ans==4*pi
assert all(value(choices[k])!=ans for k in choices if k!=answer)
